title: PR8336 two-phase Production runtime identity compatibility

phases.objective: Deploy a source-only compatibility guard that keeps the currently deployed legacy Production runtime recoverable while admitting the canonical explicit production_hostinger_autodeploy identity, without mutating Hostinger, databases, providers, credentials, or Production state.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate Recovery Kernel and System Layer Production identity guards against legacy, canonical explicit, Staging, and conflicting runtime signals.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Legacy NODE_ENV production/prod remains recoverable, canonical production_hostinger_autodeploy is accepted, Staging and conflicting identities fail closed, and Production mutation remains forbidden.
steps: Run the transitional Production runtime identity matrix against the shared compatibility predicate.
Register this critical E2E declaration exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
Verify Recovery Kernel route fixtures identify legacy Production using NODE_ENV=production rather than branch identity alone.
Verify non-Production Git refs, Staging runtime identities, and mixed Production/Staging signals fail closed.
Verify canonical explicit Hostinger Production remains accepted during the mixed rollout state.
Preserve source-only rollout boundaries: no Hostinger env mutation, database mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, Production deployment, or Control Store APPLY.
assertions: NODE_ENV=production and NODE_ENV=prod are accepted during Phase 1.
DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=production_hostinger_autodeploy is accepted as explicit canonical Production.
NODE_ENV=production plus DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=production_hostinger_autodeploy remains accepted without a lockout window.
GITHUB_REF_NAME=main, staging_local_windows_docker, and mixed Production/Staging signals are rejected.
Branch name alone is not sufficient to establish the legacy Production runtime identity.
production_mutation_allowed is false and secrets_included is false.
The PR8336 declaration is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths; autonomous merge remains forbidden.
